content: chrome.action.setBadgeText({text, tabId?}), setBadgeBackgroundColor({color, tabId?}) and setBadgeTextColor({color, tabId?}) all return Promise<void> and are callable from the service worker / extension pages; content scripts are not a listed calling context, so a content script must message the background. manifest action.default_popup is a relative path to an HTML file. Official docs: 'The popup's size must be between 25x25 and 800x600 pixels.'
